title: Pure Mystic Swordsman
summary: Mystic Swordsman is an EARTH Warrior LV archetype (Mystic Swordsman LV2, LV4, and LV6) designed to automatically destroy face-down Defense Position monsters at the start of the Damage Step without flipping them face-up or calculating damage! Because opponent monsters are normally summoned face-up, you pair the Mystic Swordsmen with Book of Moon, Book of Eclipse, and Quaking Mirror Force to force the opponent's entire board into face-down Defense Position—allowing Mystic Swordsman LV2 and LV4 to slice through any boss monster regardless of its ATK/DEF, evolve into LV6 during the End Phase, and place destroyed monsters directly on top of the opponent's Deck to lock their draws!

allow.Marauding Captain: Level 3 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons a Level 4 or lower monster (Mystic Swordsman LV4 or LV2) from your hand on Normal Summon—bypassing Mystic Swordsman LV4's Normal Summon restriction and placing it directly in Attack Position!
allow.Goblindbergh: Level 4 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons a Level 4 or lower monster from your hand in Attack Position on Normal Summon.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Mystic Swordsman LV2, Mystic Swordsman LV4, Marauding Captain, or Goblindbergh.
allow.Moon Mirror Shield: Equip Spell so Mystic Swordsman LV2/LV4 also beat any face-up Attack Position monster in battle to trigger their End Phase LV evolution!
allow.Living Fossil: Equip Spell to revive Mystic Swordsman LV2 or LV4 in face-up Attack Position.
allow.Phoenix Gearblade: Equip Spell that grants Warrior monsters a second attack during the Battle Phase.
allow.Quaking Mirror Force: Flips all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls into permanent face-down Defense Position—turning their entire board into instant 0-damage destruction targets for Mystic Swordsman LV2, LV4, and LV6!
allow.Ferocious Flame Swordsman: Link-2 Warrior made with two monsters with different names that boosts all Warriors by 500 ATK and revives a non-Link Warrior when destroyed.
allow.Aussa the Earth Charmer, Immovable: Link-2 EARTH monster made with two EARTH monsters (including Mystic Swordsman) that steals an EARTH monster from the opponent's GY.
allow.Blade Armor Ninja: Rank 4 Warrior Xyz made with two Level 4 Warriors (Mystic Swordsman LV4 + Goblindbergh) that allows a Warrior monster to attack twice per Battle Phase.
allow.Heroic Champion - Excalibur: Rank 4 Warrior Xyz made with two Level 4 Warriors that doubles its ATK to 4000.

main: Mystic Swordsman LV2

Base Level 2 EARTH Warrior (900 ATK): at the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster, immediately destroys that monster without flipping it face-up; during the End Phase, if it destroyed a monster by battle, sends itself to the GY to Special Summon Mystic Swordsman LV4 from your hand or Deck!
Mystic Swordsman LV4

Mid-tier Level 4 EARTH Warrior (1900 ATK): must be Set if Normal Summoned, but when Special Summoned in Attack Position (by LV2, Level Up!, Marauding Captain, or Goblindbergh!), automatically destroys any face-down Defense Position monster it attacks at the start of the Damage Step and evolves into Mystic Swordsman LV6 during the End Phase!
Mystic Swordsman LV6

Boss Level 6 EARTH Warrior (2300 ATK): automatically destroys any face-down Defense Position monster it attacks at the start of the Damage Step AND lets you place that destroyed monster on top of your opponent's Deck instead of sending it to the GY—locking their next draw!
Marauding Captain
Special Summons Mystic Swordsman LV4 or LV2 from your hand in Attack Position on Normal Summon.
Goblindbergh
Special Summons Mystic Swordsman LV4 or LV2 from your hand in Attack Position on Normal Summon.
Level Up!
Sends a face-up Mystic Swordsman LV2 or LV4 to the GY to immediately Special Summon Mystic Swordsman LV4 or LV6 from your hand or Deck in face-up Attack Position.
Book of Moon
Flips any face-up opponent's monster into face-down Defense Position so Mystic Swordsman LV2, LV4, or LV6 can immediately destroy it without damage calculation or Flip effects.
Book of Eclipse
Flips all face-up monsters on the field into face-down Defense Position.
Moon Mirror Shield
Ensures Mystic Swordsman LV2 and LV4 also destroy face-up Attack Position monsters by battle to trigger their End Phase evolution into LV4 and LV6.
Living Fossil
Equip Spell that revives Mystic Swordsman LV4 from the GY in face-up Attack Position.
Phoenix Gearblade
Equip Spell that recycles itself and grants Warriors a second attack.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Mystic Swordsman LV2, LV4, Marauding Captain, or Goblindbergh.
Quaking Mirror Force
Permanently flips all opponent's Attack Position monsters into face-down Defense Position so your Mystic Swordsmen can wipe them out and top-deck them with LV6!
